data.title: St Regis The Residences
data.about:
Introducing the latest addition to the luxury lifestyle of Dubai: St. Regis The Residences Downtown Dubai. 

Located in the most iconic address, Downtown Dubai, St. Regis The Residences is nestled in the Opera District. Offering an eclectic collection of 1 and 2 BR apartments with fantastic opulent interiors and views of the Opera, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, and Burj Park. With an upscale finishing, 5-star facilities, and spacious homes, these residences have a host of world-class amenities that complement the high-end life.
